title: Backend Engineer
description: Design and build scalable APIs and microservices using Node.js and PostgreSQL. You will be responsible for the backend infrastructure that serves millions of requests.
requirements:
3+ years backend experience
Node.js and Express
PostgreSQL expertise
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with RESTful API design

title: Data Analyst
description: Join our analytics team to turn data into actionable insights. You will work with large datasets, build dashboards, and present findings to stakeholders.
requirements:
2+ years in data analysis
SQL proficiency
Experience with Python and Pandas
Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Looker)
Strong communication skills

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Manage our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. You will ensure reliability, security, and scalability across all our services.
requirements:
3+ years DevOps experience
AWS or GCP expertise
Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
Kubernetes and Docker
Monitoring tools (Datadog, Prometheus)

title: ML Engineer
description: Build and deploy machine learning models at scale. You will work on recommendation systems, NLP, and computer vision projects.
requirements:
MS or PhD in CS or related field
Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Production ML deployment
Knowledge of MLOps practices
3+ years industry experience

title: Marketing Manager

requirements:
4+ years marketing experience
Content marketing and SEO expertise
Social media management
Experience with marketing automation tools
Strong analytical and communication skills

title: Product Designer

4+ years product design experience
Proficiency in Figma
Strong portfolio demonstrating UX thinking
Experience with design systems
Ability to work with cross-functional teams

title: Senior Frontend Developer

5+ years of React experience
Strong TypeScript skills
Experience with modern build tools (Vite, Webpack)
Knowledge of CSS-in-JS and Tailwind
